params.message:
Contacts no longer have a stage; the organisation stays

The stage (to approach, in conversation, promised, supports, stopped) added a choice to
every row, a filter and an action for everyone shown, for something that is kept as well in
a remark and in who in the team is the contact. It is taken off the page, the import, the
backup and the calls. A stage already set stays in the data, unused.

The organisation stays, and so do the actions standing under each other.
